verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents an official CLI at docs.hatchet.run/reference/cli, and a probe confirms the page exists. Its commands cover scaffolding (`hatchet quickstart`), local worker dev with hot reload (`hatchet worker dev`), a real-time observability TUI (`hatchet tui`) and multi-environment profiles (`hatchet profile`). Missing for 10: no evidence of AI-native or agent-friendly CLI features such as machine-readable output or scriptable run triggering, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: the `hatchet worker dev` command lets you run a worker locally with automatic reloading when code changes are detected
the `hatchet tui` command lets you interact with your Hatchet deployment through a terminal user interface (TUI) that provides real-time observability into tasks, workflows, workers, and more
the `hatchet quickstart` command generates a worker project from a template to help you get started quickly
the `hatchet profile` commands allow you to manage multiple Hatchet instances and tenants with named profiles
